&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_DOWNTIMECODEID'
		Do 'LoadDownTimeCodeIdOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_DOWNTIMECODEDESCRIPTION'
		Do 'LoadDownTimeCodeDescriptionOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_DOWNTIMECODETYPE'

EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.InterrupcionPromptGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.InterrupcionPromptGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.InterrupcionPromptGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEID"
				&TFDownTimeCodeId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEID_SEL"
				&TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEDESCRIPTION"
				&TFDownTimeCodeDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODEDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODETYPE"
				&TFDownTimeCodeType.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFDOWNTIMECODETYPE_SEL"
				&TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadDownTimeCodeIdOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFDownTimeCodeId = &SearchTxt
	&TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each
		Order DownTimeCodeId
		Where (InterrupcionId.ToString() like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (InterrupcionTiempo.ToString() like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (InterrupcionMotivo like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (DownTimeCodeId like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (DownTimeCodeDescription like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (DownTimeCodeType like !'%' + &FilterFullText) When not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		Where DownTimeCodeId like &TFDownTimeCodeId when &TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFDownTimeCodeId.IsEmpty())
		Where DownTimeCodeId = &TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel when not &TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where DownTimeCodeDescription like &TFDownTimeCodeDescription when &TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFDownTimeCodeDescription.IsEmpty())
		Where DownTimeCodeDescription = &TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel when not &TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where DownTimeCodeType like &TFDownTimeCodeType when &TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFDownTimeCodeType.IsEmpty())
		Where DownTimeCodeType = &TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel when not &TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel.IsEmpty()

		&count = 0
		For Each
			Order DownTimeCodeId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not DownTimeCodeId.IsEmpty()
			&Option = DownTimeCodeId
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
